card.title: For Everyone’s Protection
card.instruction: Protect people by creating procedures for them. Turn concern into checklists, permissions, required steps, and increasingly narrow exceptions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've written a checklist so you can safely make tea while I'm out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made tea for forty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You can initial the experience section.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cold or room temperature? I need the correct appendix.

mechanism: A turns tea-making concern into a checklist and absorbs experience or a simpler drink into narrower procedural branches.
confusable: Unlike form expertise for its own sake, A creates these requirements as protection for the other person.
comparison: The tea alternative proliferates appendices for water; the bicycle alternative restricts use to walking until both fall directions are signed off.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
